issues.description: The problem statement and the template expect an instance method addRating(stars:) (external parameter label 'stars'), but the solution's Course implementation declares the method as addRating(rating:) (external label 'rating'). At the same time the solution's Client calls addRating(stars:). This mismatch of the method parameter label is structural: it will cause compilation errors and confusion because callers (and the template) use the 'stars' label while the solution's method exposes 'rating'.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the parameter label consistent across artifacts. Change the solution's Course method signature to expose the 'stars' label (for example: func addRating(stars: Int) { ... } ), or explicitly provide an external label matching the template and client (for example: func addRating(stars rating: Int) { ... }). Ensure the Client code and any references use the same label.
